title: Package the slicer driving loop as fixed agent skills for Claude, Codex, and Grok
lead:
The deepest "do more in the tool, less in the model" move is to stop agents
re-deriving the workflow from prose each session. Ship a small, fixed skill/command
that names the four-command loop and the exit-code rules and nothing else, so the
"how do I drive slicer" reasoning lives in a static artifact rather than per-session
model tokens. Provide equivalents for the major coding agents — a Claude Code skill,
an OpenAI Codex prompt/command, and a Grok agent skill — sharing one source of truth
(`ai instructions`) so they cannot drift. Needs a little design on packaging before it
is a slice.
